nom: Bubble Sun Rise Mineral Sunscreen Stick Broad Spectrum SPF 40

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the stick as not too greasy and non-clogging, though one reviewer found it stayed oily and never fully mattified.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report it feels moisturizing and works well on dull, dry skin without feeling stripping.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, no stinging, and a gentle, lightweight feel, including one describing it as safe for very sensitive skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with textured/combination skin found it sheer and lightweight rather than sticky or thick.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention it protects against sun damage and dark spots/discoloration, though no one reports direct anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe it as moisturizing and leaving skin glowing rather than tight or flaky.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes it doesn't irritate her sensitive skin; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with protecting her skin barrier from all-day sun exposure; no barrier damage is reported.
concerns.spots: Reviewers state it prevented sunburn and helped avoid dark spots/discoloration from sun exposure.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and call it acne-safe; one reviewer with oily skin says it stayed oily but still did not cause breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers call it non-greasy and lightweight, but one reviewer found it greasy/oily and slow to absorb, and another said it stayed oily on her skin.

aspects.libelle: White cast on darker skin tones
Wears well under and over makeup
Slow absorption, greasy feel for some

extraits.titre: If you are a brown person I would pass
extraits.texte: The only Issue that I have with the sunscreen is that it leaves a very visible white cast. Even as I blend it into the skin, it leaves my face looking purple and gray. If I'm wearing makeup, it's manageable, but on no makeup days, I would pass.

extraits.titre: Really Like This on my Brown Skin!
extraits.texte: I'm a brown girly and when applied does have a white cast at first, but after rubbing it in...it looks amazing. It absorbs into the skin well, and I don't have a visible white cast anymore. Love that it's mineral based. I wear on no makeup days.

I've tried a few western as well as asian sunsticks from Shiseido, ABIB, and TOCOBO. I got this one on a whim because i needed a new sunstick to travel with for application on the go. I will say it's a bit greasy/oily and it takes a while to absorb in my experience. If you can look past that, this is a good one that I mainly use for reapplication on my hands and neck.

This is the best sunscreen ever! Me and my friend both have very bad acne and live every bubble product we talk about them all every day all day, we both get 2-8 new products every week and can never wait until bubble releases new product we Love reviewing and giving honest reviews! And this is one you can't pass up.

extraits.titre: Me encantó el Sun Rise Bubble!
extraits.texte: Me encantó el Sun Rise Bubble de Bubble Skincare! Es un protector solar mineral ligero y no grasoso que se absorbe rápidamente en la piel. La fórmula es suave y no irrita mi piel sensible. Me gusta que sea fácil de aplicar y no deja una capa blanca. Lo uso todos los días como parte de mi rutina de cuidado de la piel y me ha ayudado a prevenir quemaduras solares. ¡Lo recomiendo!"
I've been using this sunscreen stick and I'm actually OBSESSED. As someone with acne-prone skin, I'm really picky with SPF… and this one did NOT break me out.
This sun rise mineral works wonderful in my dry skin. And also I have sensitive skin and it doesn't cause me any irritation
